guidelines.title: Eco-Friendly Visarjan ke Zaroori Niyam
guidelines.subtitle: NGT orders aur CPCB rules ke mutabik Bhopal ke paani ko surakshit rakhein.
guidelines.dos_title: Devotees aur Samitis ko kya karna chahiye
guidelines.do_1: Murti visarjan sirf BMC ke banaye artificial kunds me hi karein.
guidelines.do_2: Visarjan se pehle phool, maala, kapde aur plastic decorations nikal lein.
guidelines.do_3: Puja samagri ko ghat par lage 'Nirmalya Kalash' me hi daalein.
guidelines.do_4: Natural mitti (mitti/shhadu) aur natural rangon wali murtiyan choose karein.
guidelines.dont_1: Bade Talab ya Chhote Talab ke direct paani me visarjan bilkul na karein.
guidelines.dont_2: Plastic bags, thermocol ya chemical rang paani me na phekhein.
guidelines.dont_3: Barricades tod kar deep water me na utrein.
guidelines.dont_4: Visarjan ke baad road par ya ghat par kachra na chodein.

faq.title: Aksar Pooche Jaane Wale Sawaal (FAQs)
faq.subtitle: Visarjan rules, ghat arrangements aur water testing ki clear jankari.
faq.q1: Is saal bade pandals ki murtiyon ka visarjan kahan hoga?
faq.a1: Badi murtiyon ke liye BMC ne Bairagarh (Sant Hirdaram Kund), Prempura artificial tanks aur Khatlapura enclosure banaye hain. Talab ke direct paani me visarjan NGT dwara strictly banned hai.
faq.q2: Dissolved Oxygen (DO) kya hota hai aur yeh zaroori kyun hai?
faq.a2: Dissolved Oxygen paani me ghuli oxygen hai jo machhliyon aur aquatic life ke liye zaroori hoti hai. CPCB Class B ke liye minimum 5.0 mg/L honi chahiye. Pollution badhne par yeh kam ho jaati hai.
faq.q3: Kya ghats par cranes aur divers ki suvidha hai?
faq.a3: Haan, Bhopal Municipal Corporation aur SDRF ke trained divers, rescue boats aur hydraulic cranes sabhi 7 ghats par 24 ghante maujood rehte hain.
faq.q4: Nirmalya (puja ke phool aur samagri) ka kya hoga?
faq.a4: BMC ne ghats par peele Nirmalya Vahan aur special bins lagaye hain. Inka use sacred compost banane ke liye kiya jaata hai.
faq.q5: Kya visarjan slot book karne ki koi fees hai?
faq.a5: Nahi, Visarjan slot registration bilkul FREE hai. Iska maqsad sirf ghat par traffic aur bheed control karna hai.
